title: Nodes reference code at a commit, not diffs
statement: A reference says this node explains these lines, as of this commit: repository, commit, path, line range, and content digest. A diff is never stored; it is a way of viewing references against two commits.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Deletions reference the base commit; renames and binary changes reference whole files.

Staleness compares the pinned commit with the viewed one: if the lines only moved, the range is remapped automatically; if they changed, the reference is stale and the diff since the pin can be shown.
At merge, references are re-pinned to the commit that landed, so squash merges and deleted branches lose nothing; the content digest finds the same lines in any commit as a fallback.
Commits that only change the Saga leave the code identical, so their remap is a no-op.
